requirements.text: Strong understanding of model-based systems engineering (MBSE) applied to complex multidisciplinary engineering programmes
Strong understanding of rocketry and how vehicle subsystems interact across the complete system
Experience leading systems engineering work, system interfaces, or cross-disciplinary technical efforts on complex engineering projects
A proven track record of successfully completing engineering projects
Ability to maintain a vehicle-level perspective while engaging with avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC and other technical teams
Define, own, and resolve system interfaces across technical departments
Lead cross-disciplinary systems discussions and reviews, resolve technical conflicts, and ensure decisions are clearly recorded
Identify and manage interdependencies, assumptions, constraints and cross-subsystem impacts
Track issues and interface actions through to resolution
Confidence facilitating technical decisions and managing competing subsystem needs
Comfortable working extended hours with high autonomy in a fast-paced startup (48-hour working week)

resumes.text:
Elena Varga
Summary: Systems engineer with 9 years leading vehicle-level engineering on propulsion and launch hardware. Known for keeping a whole-system view while driving disciplines to agreement. Confident facilitating technical decisions and balancing competing subsystem needs.

Experience
Lead Systems Engineer, Helix Aerospace GmbH (Munich), 2021 to 2025
- Led systems engineering work on a 40-person launch vehicle programme. Wrote and maintained the system architecture using model-based systems engineering (MBSE) in SysML v2, linking requirements, functions and interfaces in one model.
- Defined and owned interface control documents between structures and propulsion, resolving over 60 interface disputes within two review cycles.
- Kept the whole-system picture across the avionics, software, structures, propulsion and guidance teams, so trade-offs were judged at vehicle level rather than inside one department.
- Chaired cross-disciplinary design reviews, resolved technical conflicts and recorded every decision in a shared review log.
- Mapped cross-subsystem dependencies, assumptions and constraints in a shared register that was updated as the design matured.
- Tracked system-level issues and interface actions through to closure. Average action age dropped from 34 days to 9.
- Track record of completing engineering projects on schedule, including the first integrated static fire of a solid motor test vehicle.

Systems Engineer, Brandt Vibration Systems, 2016 to 2021
- Built test plans for vibration qualification of avionics boxes for satellite customers.
- Supported the propulsion group in analysing how propellant feed dynamics and thrust vector control loops interact during a burn, which fed directly into the flight software timing budget.

Education
MSc Aerospace Engineering, TU Braunschweig, 2016
BSc Mechanical Engineering, University of Stuttgart, 2014

Skills
SysML v2, Cameo Systems Modeler, requirements management, interface control, technical risk registers, Python for data analysis. Fluent in German and English.

Availability
Fixed 37.5-hour contracts with no out-of-hours work. Prefers predictable schedules.

Tomas Lindqvist
Summary: Test engineer turned systems engineer with 6 years in propulsion test and small spacecraft work. Strong hands-on background with a growing system-level scope.

Experience
Systems Engineer, Nordic Thrust Lab (Stockholm), 2022 to 2025
- Led systems engineering work on a cross-disciplinary test-bed programme spanning propulsion and avionics.
- Track record of successfully completing engineering projects, including two test-bed upgrades delivered within budget.
- Ran hot-fire test campaigns for a solid motor and analysed how igniter timing affected chamber pressure rise.
- Coordinated interface control documents between the structures and avionics groups, which held through two design freezes.
- Managed interdependencies and constraints across subsystems on the test bed.
- Systems engineering practice relied on Excel requirement matrices and Word-based interface documents throughout.
- Ran weekly design reviews within the propulsion group only.
- Maintained an issue tracker for the test-bed team, closing items at sprint end without follow-up across teams.

Test Engineer, Vanerholm Aero Components, 2019 to 2022
- Performed vibration and thermal qualification tests on machined structural brackets and sensor housings.
- Wrote test procedures and reported results to programme engineers.
- Set up the data acquisition system for thermal cycling rigs and trained two technicians on its use.
- Reviewed test anomalies with the supplier and documented root causes in the lab notebook, which the quality team used in audits.
- Managed a small budget for test consumables and equipment calibration, keeping the lab within plan for three years running.

Education
BSc Mechanical Engineering, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, 2019

Skills
Test planning, data acquisition (LabVIEW), Excel, Word, SolidWorks CAD, Python for data analysis. Fluent in Swedish and English.

Priya Shah
Summary: Restaurant and hospitality operations manager with 8 years running busy venues. Focused on guest experience, staff scheduling and cost control.

Experience
Operations Manager, The Copper Fork (Hamburg), 2021 to 2025
- Managed daily operations for a 120-seat restaurant with a team of 35 staff.
- Logged every escalated customer issue and followed it through with the kitchen and front-of-house staff until the guest was satisfied. Repeat complaints fell by half.
- Comfortable working 50-hour weeks through seasonal peaks such as festival season and the Christmas period.
- Reduced food waste by 18% through weekly stock reviews and revised par levels.
- Hired and trained 12 new staff members across two peak seasons, with a retention rate above 80 percent.
- Negotiated supplier contracts for produce and drinks, saving about 9 percent on annual purchasing costs.
- Prepared monthly profit and loss reports for the owners and reviewed them line by line with the head chef.
- Introduced a shift handover checklist that reduced service errors reported by guests during busy evenings. Named Employee of the Year in 2024 for leading the team through a difficult refurbishment.

Assistant Manager, Lindenhof Hotel Group, 2017 to 2021
- Project coordinator for 14 retail store fit-outs for a sister brand, all delivered on schedule.
- Trained new hires on hygiene standards and table service.
- Built the monthly rota and managed a payroll budget of 400,000 euros a year.

Education
BA Hospitality Management, Hamburg University of Applied Sciences, 2016

Skills
Rota planning, POS systems, budgeting, customer service, Microsoft Office. Fluent in German and English.
